description:
Proposal page (approved 2026-11-12): https://claude.ai/artifact/TboWBs17qJ25eNNhgjEmd6 (local /Users/j5n/Workspace/gh-304.html, version 2). Closes GitHub #304.

The interpreter's environment is HashMap<ValueId, BackendBoundValue> (src/ir_interp/backend.rs), rebuilt per entry. Remedy: a flat frame indexed by value id, sized from the Lowerer's value count (ids are not dense: 1,010 of 19,121 executables have gaps, worst ratio 16.5), inline lanes, and a retention trim so a parked frame holds only the target entry's captures (without it three GC pins rise).

Measured on the spike: 6.2 -> 3.63 us/element release, 69 -> 38.5 debug.

Spike: /Users/j5n/Workspace/gh-304-spikes/spike-S2-final4.patch (10 files, +229 -131, applies to d2ecc9d48).

The page's ticket 4 (dev opt-level 1) is PR #313.

Neighbour: PR #310 (fz-sc8.7) changes how the ir_interp driver ends (sched_core::end_quantum, process_ended, halted().unwrap_or(0)); expect a conflict on the driver's exit path.
title: The interpreter holds a frame, not a hash map
